inputs.content: Elementary finite-dimensional Hermitian and real linear algebra; number-field rings of integers as Dedekind domains, local freeness of finite projective lattices, different/codifferent definitions and integral trace discriminants; elementary finite-index determinants, real scalar extension and local integrality; Lebesgue change of variables, Tonelli and countable additivity. The exact trace determinant, diagonal factor, rational lattice dictionary, group chart, fundamental domains and reference normalization are proved in this manuscript rather than retained as inputs.

An arbitrary original D7 and supplied HidaSetting with its literal coefficient isomorphism, actual unimodular L0 and Lam_split, hyperbolic vectors, all word vectors/local frames, finite frame congruences and xu. The CovolRef conclusion accepts every original bridge, both domains and HypX. This does not construct the ambient setting or infer Forms0. No extra measure, covolume, level-membership, row-lattice or discriminant hypothesis is imposed.

remaining_downstream_boundaries: Original local JacGauge/all-section disintegration, including exact RhsWLim or another fully proved supplier with the same measure constants
Exact PlaceSplit consumer and full ProdExact for arbitrary sigma-finite local factorizations, then RealBracket with the already supplied AprimeInf/GaugeDens interfaces
Independent finite-place factors, remaining mass/index/counting/form fields and exact global spectral identifications
Ambient Forms0 and original all-family Transport/LevelMatch, Bessel uniqueness/local ties and coherent final joins
